reviews.text:
Thank you to the veterinary team and staff who cared for my cat Luna with respect and professionalism from the beginning of her life until the end.

I appreciated the team's kindness and compassion during both happy and difficult times.
Excellent service... highly recommended! 👌 …

I waited for 7h to have my dog checked. After 500$ spent, for them put him to sleep and just touch his leg, there was nothing they could tell me as to why he can't walk.  They kept trying to sell me different procedures 'to find out'. And ended up just prescribing medication. I then booked at another vet that cost a 5th of the price and told me within 5 minutes he has a luxation of the rotula.
The doctors who examined him were in their early twenties and had no idea what they were doing.
Unless you have an emergency (which I did given how my dog was hiding, unresponsive, wouldn't eat, drink or go outside for his needs) and it was 10pm ... book with a vet in a clinic that actually has competent and experienced staff.

Literally some of the least competent and unmotivated staff coupled with some of the poorest staff organization/communication.  has led to poorest customer experience I’ve had  in a vet clinic.

After making an appointment 4 days prior and being reassured on the phone that i had all the paper work necessary to get a monthly injection for my dog. I’ve had to see/deal with 3 people all off which gave me different reasons why they couldn’t do it. It was left to me to offer solutions.

Never once have they been proactive or actually helpful, just lots of excuses.

I’m currently writing from the waiting room 2 hours after arriving and it’s clear that I’m not the only one that has been waiting.

They may be less expensive but save yourself the time and headache and go somewhere else.

We rescued a stray cat yesterday and brought him to this clinic today. The staff was very kind, and the vet was very understanding of our situation. He didn't push for further treatment, knowing we weren't sure we could keep him. He gave us everything we needed to make him safe to keep in the same house as our other pets and suggested we come back if we decided to keep him for additional care. The prices are also very reasonable ($100 for the examination and about $100 for the deworming treatment). We will definitely go back for our other furry friends!
I had to euthanize my old companion of the last 16 years because their prices are too high.

The service itself was okay, even if it's more expensive than elsewhere, even though I felt pressured to do absolutely unnecessary tests to charge me more money, but charging me $40 for a written prescription because I consider buying my medication from the person who prescribes it to be a major conflict of interest, that's unacceptable... I call them scammers....

A very disappointing and hurtful experience for my dog

I am extremely disappointed and upset by the treatment my dog ​​received at this clinic. During a scheduled operation, the staff removed hair from his ears without informing me or obtaining my consent. As a result, his ears are now very inflamed, painful, and infected, as you can see in the photos.

Not only was this procedure not planned, but no one mentioned it to me when I picked up my dog. It was only when I saw how much pain he was in that I understood what had been done.

I find this unacceptable, irresponsible, and unprofessional. My dog ​​is suffering because of something I never authorized.

I am sharing my experience to warn other pet owners: make sure that no procedure is performed without your written consent. I have lost all trust in them.

After a year of waiting, I finally received a response from the Veterinary Medical Association regarding my complaint.

I find it really sad that it took so long. My dog ​​has changed over the past year. He used to trust people. Now he's afraid of humans. His way of defending himself is to bark or even try to bite, because he seems to have lost all trust since what happened.

I may never know how he was handled while he was at the clinic. I was also told he had feces stuck to his hindquarters and that they had to be removed. I wonder how long he had been like that and if he had been left in his crate for a long time without anyone noticing. I can't say for sure what happened, but these questions still haunt me.

I know my dog. When he has stuck feces, he's very uncomfortable and he cries. He's a member of my family, and seeing him change so much since this incident breaks my heart.

I find it sad how little protection our animals sometimes receive. They have no voice to speak out about what they've been through. My goal was never to attack anyone. I simply wanted what happened to my dog ​​to be taken seriously and for other families not to have to go through the same thing.
Yesterday, my cat Monkey went to get vaccinated. We had an appointment with Dr. Nozry, but we were ultimately seen by Dr. Dermininasyan. It seems there was a mistake at reception.

Our first visit to the Journet Veterinary Hospital was extremely reassuring for our 15-week-old puppy! From the moment we arrived, we received a wonderful welcome that immediately put us at ease. Dr. Journet was patient: he took all the time necessary to thoroughly examine our companion, explaining each step of the examination to us. We highly recommend this clinic for its professionalism, attentiveness, and the quality of its care!

Excellent service! The whole team is warm and immediately puts you at ease. Dr. Journet took the time to examine Romy very gently. You can feel their genuine concern for animal welfare. A very good experience. I highly recommend this establishment.
Thank you Dr. Journet for your compassion and humanism.
Excellent clinic

The team at this veterinary hospital is extraordinary. From the receptionists and technicians to the veterinarians, they are all very caring and give so much love to our beloved companions. Their hearts beat for our furry friends too. Thank you, Dr. Journet, for choosing such wonderful people like yourself to surround yourself with. Mio joins me in sending a big hug to the whole team!

I got a very quick appointment for a consultation, the prices were reasonable, but they told me they would have preferred my cat to be vaccinated before I brought him in. However, they vaccinated him anyway since I was already there.

Really sweet staff, the best comprehensive vet and with a love of pets like no other. We truly love this place for our cat and she has been there since 9 years
The prices are great
We recommend

Dr. Guingouain truly cares about the well-being of my Tonkinese cats. He knows the breed well and answered all my questions with interest and passion. He is gentle and patient and even let the little rascals climb on his shoulders! The reception staff are kind and I highly recommend this establishment.
Very good team, listens to your needs, thank you!

Before authorizing the transfer of my file to another veterinary hospital, I wanted to express my gratitude to Dr. Journet and his team for their care of my cat, Toutoune, whom they've known since she was a kitten. She will be 13 years old on May 6th. The file transfer has no connection whatsoever with the prices or services they offer.

As the years went by, I became a little more vulnerable for specific reasons. During a consultation for my cat, there was a situation that allowed Dr. Journet to get to know me personally. He treated me very well. I rarely open up, so it made me feel uneasy and hesitant to return.

Once again, I have nothing against Dr. Journet and his team. They have always been there for my cat, providing vaccinations, deworming treatments, and prescribing a shampoo since she was/is allergic to flea bites. They even boarded her when I was feeling unwell. The team had taken care to put her in a kennel because of her behavior with the other cats.

Thank you for your help.

Thank you Dr. Journet for the excellent service with Biscuit. A very competent doctor who understands his patients' needs and provides follow-up after consultations. This isn't our first time at this clinic, and we are very satisfied once again.

After 4-5 visits: they really push for additional services at extra cost. With some vets, you can feel the pressure and sense of urgency. The vet even goes so far as to lecture you, which is frankly irritating.

I went to another vet for 4 years, and I never felt any "urgency" regarding a service, a vaccination, or any kind of follow-up.

The most disgusting bad mannered staff I’ve ever encountered in my life. Please don’t go here. My cat passed away and I came here and this place just made everything 100 times worst. You should probably start hiring compassionate kind people not 20 year old little jerks who don’t know how to act.

Dr. Jerar Derminasyan is absolutely the best veterinarian in this clinic—honestly, I would even say in Montreal. I’ve tried many different vets in the city and no one else has shown the same level of knowledge and compassion as he has. He brought my dog back from death I would say. I’m so thankful. His expertise and passion for his work are truly incredible. He is the perfect person for this role.
The clinic itself has an amazing, polite staff, and they are not greedy for money like most of the places in Montreal. They genuinely care about helping your pets. I’ve been with them for almost two years and visit often because my dog is older. I definitely recommend them.
Highly competent and welcoming staff
The veterinarian and the humans who work there are all fantastic.

A huge thank you to Dr. Jerar Derminasyan at Clinique Journet for his professionalism and compassion. You can tell he genuinely loves his patients: he even takes the time to take a picture of my dog ​​Rufus at every visit to send to his wife!

Rufus loves him dearly in return, which makes appointments so much easier. His calm approach, empathy, and high level of expertise make him a rare gem. I recommend him without hesitation!

My cat ran away for five weeks in October. When I found her, I brought her to this clinic. She has many scars on her body from her outdoor adventure.
The staff are truly caring and the care is excellent. A superb veterinarian.
Losing our beloved 16-year-old Hugo has been heart-breaking! We miss him every day. Dr. Journet and his very nice assistant helped us through this very difficult process with kindness and compassion.

Repeatedly terrible veterinary experiences for various reasons.
I strongly advise against going there and encourage you to seek help at other clinics.
Dr. Charles Guingouain, thank you for Max.
Thank you for your trust, Sylvia!

Thank you for all these years. You cared for my Penny with passion and compassion until the very end, and

for 13 years. You make a wonderful team, and I am deeply grateful to Dr. Derminasyan for today. You had the right words and, as always, were kind, professional, and made us feel at ease. I love you all. Thank you.
Really expensive and designed to make you pay, pay, and pay again.

My vet of choice! They are extremely understanding, kind, and helpful. They take the time to understand their clients' situations. I occasionally look after dogs, and over time, I've had to use their services for emergencies. They were able to accommodate me quickly and with the utmost kindness.

I love this clinic. The receptionists, the technicians, the veterinarians—we're so lucky to have chosen this place for our cats. Our cat had to have two surgeries for cancer, and the staff was remarkably kind. Our cat hates going to the vet, but they took it in stride and still treated him well; you can tell they love animals. A cancer diagnosis isn't easy, but we felt we were in good hands, and that made a huge difference.

So grateful to the whole team, Dr. Lussier, all the technicians, and the smiling reception staff. Thank you!

I recommend this hospital 100%.

I appreciate the professionalism of the veterinarians; the clinic is clean and the reception staff are very welcoming. We have access to several specialists. They take the time to call to check on our animals. They truly care about the well-being of our pets!

I went to an emergency appointment with my cat, who had blood in her urine. Given that this was her third major health problem in six months (unexplained fever, respiratory issues), in addition to chronic allergies requiring immunosuppressants that were difficult to tolerate, I was sadly considering euthanasia, thinking she was suffering too much.

During the consultation, I explained my cat's complex medical history to the veterinarian and my desire not to prolong her suffering. However, she convinced me to run tests and try treatment.
I shared my concerns about the three prescribed medications, knowing that two of them are harsh on the stomach, and that she had just started a new medication with digestive side effects.
Despite my fears, I was told there was no other option.

Two days later, my cat completely stopped eating and drinking, vomited, and I had to give her water with a syringe. I called to arrange for euthanasia at home, but since the wait was several days, I agreed to an appointment at the clinic, as she was very ill.

At the appointment, I met Dr. Journet. My cat seemed momentarily more alert (probably due to stress), and the veterinarian made me feel incredibly guilty about my decision. Despite my explanations and my pet's recurring suffering, he downplayed the situation, claiming it was simply a digestive upset that was "easy to fix."

He also criticized the food I was giving her (my usual clinic hadn't said anything about it and it wasn't related to her current condition), wrongly claiming it was causing blockages—at the first visit, I was told my cat had cystitis.

After a long discussion, I finally agreed to the proposed treatment. The veterinarian insisted I buy a urinary food sold at the clinic, stating that the cost was similar to the food I was using. However, it was more expensive and contained chicken, an ingredient my cat is allergic to, even though I had specifically mentioned this allergy.

He also decided to administer the antibiotic by injection and stop the other medications. When I asked him why this hadn't been done during the first visit (even though I had repeatedly emphasized my cat's digestive problems), he replied that "it's the protocol."
Back home, my cat again refused to eat for 24 hours, despite the anti-nausea and appetite stimulants. I finally gave her her pain medication again (which has no digestive risk), and she started eating again afterward.

Two days later, the clinic contacted me to offer FIV/FeLV tests. I had already informed them of the negative results of tests I had done months earlier—which demonstrates a blatant lack of follow-up. I also had to call twice to obtain her medical records, delaying the resumption of her allergy medication and leaving her without treatment for several days.

In short, I find it deplorable that the treatments weren't tailored from the outset. If my concerns had been heard, the injectable antibiotic could have been administered immediately, thus preventing unnecessary suffering. I could also have been recommended a safe food instead of one containing an allergenic ingredient.

This experience left me with the feeling that my pet's well-being wasn't the priority, and that the decisions were driven more by financial considerations than by compassion or professionalism. My cat suffered needlessly because of unqualified staff.

I would like to thank Dr. Journet for his excellent advice regarding Caramelle's arthritis.

The very evening of the injection, she was happily walking up and down the stairs and has resumed all her usual activities!

Thank you from the bottom of my heart! 😻😍
Stella and Guy are satisfied customers! :p Thank you so much

The receptionists are so kind and welcoming! Special mention to Danielle, with whom I spoke on the phone (impeccable service), who greeted me with a lovely smile along with her colleague; it was so nice to hear. I also want to thank Dr. Hurtubise and the technician (I've forgotten his name, sorry!) for their professionalism while also being very friendly and understanding of my situation and my aggressive cat at the clinic (I didn't have any sedatives). The prices are very reasonable for the quality of care and services offered. I highly recommend them!

Excellent service and follow-up.

And I must clarify a few things: the medications that are said to be cheaper at the pharmacy are the opposite of what I experienced. Buying them first at the pharmacy and then at the vet is about 3 to 4 times cheaper for clopidogrel and furosemide. It's worth asking for the peri-tablet information.

I simply want to express my sincere appreciation for the services I've received over the past five years at Journet. I've always received excellent service, and the vets and technicians are all incredibly patient, compassionate, and dedicated to providing the best for our animals and us, their humans. It's with a heavy heart that I have to find another clinic because of my move, as otherwise, I wouldn't have wanted to go anywhere else to care for my cat. Thank you so much for your wonderful services!
I trust them entirely with my pooch. Update: I lost my first pooch, they were very accommodating. I now trust them entirely with my two pooches.

Disappointing experience. We're used to vet visits since our cat has needed monthly checkups for over a year and a half. In just a few weeks, there have been several irregularities in the service at Journet. First, we make an appointment, but they forget to record it on their end. Then, on a few occasions, they don't email us our bill. Furthermore, five or six times, we had a blood test done for our cat at a cost of $33.56. This is roughly the amount we paid at our previous clinic. During our last visit, to our surprise, the price jumped to $88! We were then told that there was a cost for the test itself and a cost for the procedure. We wondered why we paid $33.56 all the other times. It seems they made a mistake every time! We just called another clinic and the cost for the same test is $42. So many mistakes in such a short time. I believe the veterinarians are doing their best, but there seem to be many shortcomings within the organization. We've lost confidence and we're switching clinics.

The service provided by the weekend team is wonderful. The two receptionists, Marie-Ève ​​and Mélissa, offer impeccable service and pamper your pet as if it were their own. My little Gandalf adores them.

I highly recommend this veterinary hospital! My cat needed to be neutered as soon as possible. I called everywhere, and they kept promising me an appointment in three months (I couldn't afford to wait that long). I called, and the receptionist (who was a sweetheart) found me an appointment in two days. My Highland Lynx went there from Thursday to Friday because I wanted him to have a checkup, microchipped, etc., as well as neutered. Once my cat was back home, everything went well. I had a few worries, but despite my numerous calls, Journet Hospital always answered and reassured me. Don't hesitate to make an appointment here; their team is amazing.

I've been using this clinic for three years. The staff is available, friendly, and patient. When the time came, they kindly agreed to euthanize my cat at home. And when a problem arose, the administration did everything in its power to rectify the situation and ensure we ended our relationship on a positive note.

Thank you for helping me take care of my Chumby.

We're being asked to pay a $100+tax annual general consultation fee just so my cat can get his flea medication before he goes outside. Medication he's been using for years.

Vet clinics in Quebec are tough. They'll do anything to squeeze every last cent out of you as soon as possible.
Very friendly and welcoming, a great first experience with Dr. Derminasyan!

I've been coming to this clinic for 8 years and they are wonderful. The vets and techs are kind animal lovers. They offer efficient tests and usually have a variety of options (on-site results vs off-site) to help fit different budgets.
6 years ago I had to put my cat Max down and I did it in the clinic and they gave me so much time to be with him before giving the final injection. Now yesterday I had to have my sweet senior cat euthanized and they came to my home to do it. I can't thank them enough for offering this service, I know my kitty was more comfortable to be at home for the end of her life.  They had such compassion, I can't imagine how difficult it must be to go to work and have to help an animal cross over..  thank you so much for everything you do 🙏🏽❤️🐾
Thank you for your trust, Chloé!

Left in the waiting room for an hour – the vet thought he'd seen my pet even though it was my first appointment at this clinic. "Sorry, the vet thought he'd already seen him based on his schedule check," the receptionist told me. Parking fees, wasted time – I can't even imagine what would have happened in the opposite situation!

Excellent service from the entire team, from the reception staff and technicians to Dr. Journet. Everyone is patient, attentive, and does a great job. Of course, the care is expensive, but highly trained staff, specialized equipment, and prime location are worth the investment. Highly recommended.

Excellent work. Great team. Everyone is kind and professional, from Dr. Journet to his colleagues.

As for the price, we Quebecers are completely out of touch with the healthcare system's pricing because we don't see it. We therefore assume it's "free" or "inexpensive."

I called to find out the price to have my cat euthanized. The receptionist told me around $300. I told her I thought that was expensive, and she replied that it was for the euthanasia and a consultation with the vet for the end of life. The cat was small and thin, so not very heavy. They charged me $467. They're thieves and they're taking advantage of the situation. I don't recommend this place; only money matters to them. Really disappointed.
Very bad.
Extremely expensive and unprofessional. High-pressure sales tactics; avoid them.
Extremely expensive, especially for vulnerable people; in addition to an inflated bill, they don't find the animal's health problem.

$400+ to euthanize my cat who was howling in agony. Half that elsewhere, or offered for free by an organization. I obviously chose the organization, being as poor as Job. I only bought food at Journet's, back when I could afford it. I remember that when I was paying at the counter, I mentioned that I was thinking of switching to homemade food prepared specifically for my cats, and they strongly advised against it, as if I wanted to poison them. I gave them my reasons, and when they realized I wasn't (anymore) a fool they could manipulate, they went and got a cat recipe book and tried to sell it to me, hahaha. They never got another cent from me.

Today, I had a terrible experience that made me realize how much to worry about scams. A consultation, just for a general check-up, cost me $200? Is it normal to charge clients that much? Especially since I left the appointment feeling completely uneasy. A veterinarian should love animals and want to find an effective solution, not charge exorbitant prices just for talking and not really knowing what to do. It was a complete lack of professionalism and showed no feeling or empathy. I wouldn't recommend this experience to anyone. I'll avoid Journet from now on and go to a veterinarian who loves their work and shows a lot of empathy for animals.

I received an emergency appointment today for Salem. Excellent service. All the prescribed care and treatments were explained to me very clearly.
Thank you to the entire team.
Dr. Journet was outstanding. The staff was nice and able to get us in same day.
Excellent service! I managed to get a same-day appointment for my little Pasha, who wasn't feeling well. Dr. Journet and his team provided fantastic service. I highly recommend them.

I was seen as an emergency patient for my cat, who didn't have a file at this clinic. The reception staff were very kind and friendly. Dr. Derminasyan, the veterinarian, was efficient and I appreciated his care.
I cannot thank them enough for helping us euthanize our precious Cat Kimchi. They were caring professional and so empathetic.  Not $$$$ oriented but excellent care
Competent, professional and friendly staff.

I absolutely loved everything: the welcome, the service, the respect for my budget, and the care. The vet really took her time to examine my cat thoroughly; she was gentle and so kind. She also took the time to explain everything to me and gave me a quote for the next steps so I could plan my budget accordingly. It was my first time there, and I will definitely continue to use their services in the future.
Thank you for your comments, Chloé!
